seq.subject: A homepage idea for {{business}}
seq.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

{{hook}}

Why it matters: most people look a business up online before they call. When someone searches for a {{niche}} in {{city}}, the businesses with a website usually win that call, because the site has already answered their questions. A simple website lets you:
- show every service you provide and the areas you cover
- take quote requests, even after hours
- put your reviews and photos in one place
- show up in more Google searches, not only on Maps

I run Bilder Labs, a small web design studio. I'd like to design a homepage mock-up for {{business}}. It's yours to keep, whether we end up working together or not.

All it takes is a short reply to three questions:
1. What should a visitor do first: call you, request a quote, or book?
2. Which two or three services or strengths should stand out?
3. Any colours, logo or website you like the look of? (Fine to skip.)

I'll send the design back within 3 business days as an image you can open on your phone.

{{sender}}
Bilder Labs | bilderlabs.com
[Your business postal address]
